title: Influence and singleton Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone, and let $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Its influence at coordinate $i$ equals its Fourier coefficient on the singleton set $\{i\}$: $\operatorname{Inf}_i(f)=\widehat f(\{i\})$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function from $\{-1,1\}^n$ to $\{-1,1\}$
